criteria.smalltalk: Greeting, thanks, farewell or casual chat with the assistant that asks for no information.
criteria.out_of_scope: A meaningful message clearly unrelated to INSTIKI or to being a student there: sports results, celebrities, politics, general trivia, news, weather, recipes, shopping advice, general coding or technology help, or asking the assistant to do homework or write creative text. criteria.smalltalk: Greeting, thanks, farewell or casual chat with the assistant that asks for no information.
criteria.out_of_scope: A meaningful message clearly unrelated to INSTIKI or to being a student there: sports results, celebrities, politics, general trivia, news, weather, recipes, shopping advice, general coding or technology help, or asking the assistant to do homework or write creative text.
